tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List Upwork accounts: org_uid and name.

tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description: action 'search' (params: query, sort, limit, cursor) returns job postings newest first; action 'get' (params: id — the numeric job id, a ~02… ciphertext or a job URL; job_id is an alias) returns the full posting with client stats, proposals count, connects price, screening questions.

tools.name: manage_proposals
tools.description: action 'create' (params: job_reference — the numeric job id, cover_letter, charged_amount — a number; fixed price also estimated_duration — less_than_1_month / 1_to_3_months / 3_to_6_months / more_than_6_months — and payment_mode — by_milestone with milestones [{description, amount}] or by_project; optional answers [{question, answer}], boost_connects) builds a proposal preview for a job (screening questions, bid statistics, boost auction) without submitting; action 'accept_invitation' (params: invitation_uid, cover_letter, bid, the fixed-price terms as for create) the same for invitations.

tools.name: confirm_preview
tools.description: SUBMITS the proposal built by manage_proposals. Irreversible; spends connects.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: action 'get' returns the freelancer profile (title, overview, skills, hourly rate); action 'list_highlights' returns portfolio projects with ids.

tools.name: get_freelancer_financials
tools.description: action 'connects_balance' returns the connects balance and usage history (paged by cursor).

tools.name: list_freelancer_proposals
tools.description: action 'list' (params: status — one of Pending, Accepted, Activated, Offered, Archived…; sort; limit; cursor) returns the freelancer's proposals with their job ids, newest first; action 'invitations' (params: status) returns the invitations the freelancer received, with their job ids; action 'get' returns one proposal. Actions: list, invitations, get, get_room.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: List rooms, find rooms by context, and read messages. Actions: list_rooms, search_rooms, find_room, list_messages, get_message.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: View and search your contracts. Actions: search, list, get, timesheets, end_reasons.
